newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils closed mixed, tradeless afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils closed mixed, tradeless afternoon.

text.p: European vegetable oils closed mixed after an afternoon in which actual trade proved impossible to find, traders said.
Apart from the soft oils which dipped slightly in the afternoon on the back of a similar move on the Chicago soybean oil futures, the market lacked directional input, they added.
At the close the soft oils were one to 1.25 guilders down.

The palm oil sector finished unchanged from its midday levels, when it was unchanged to $2.50 lower. During the morning it Aug traded at $512.50 and $552.50 on RBD oil and palm olein respectively. Palm stearin fetched $390/$392.50 for 1-7 July.
The lauric oils ended $2.50 easier to $5 firmer.
